data.description:
## Context
docs/mutation-testing.md records excellent 99-100% mapped scores for selected behavioral cores and explicitly distinguishes behavioral tests from structural tripwires, but the evidence is dated June/July 2026 and no workflow runs mutmut. Without periodic execution, future test weakening or new survivors can silently invalidate the evidence.

## Plan
- Add a bounded scheduled/manual mutation lane using the existing selected mutmut shards.
- Compare results with checked-in per-shard baselines.
- Fail on score regression or new survivors, not on unrelated unselected production code.
- Preserve documentation mapping each shard to the behavior its tests protect.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A scheduled or manually dispatchable CI job runs every currently documented selected mutation shard.
- [ ] The job fails when a known killed mutant survives or a shard score regresses.
- [ ] Runtime is bounded and does not block ordinary patchset CI.
- [ ] Results identify shard, killed/survived counts, and changed baseline.
- [ ] docs/mutation-testing.md records the automation cadence and most recent verified scores.
data.title: Schedule bounded mutation-score regression checks for selected behavioral cores
